title: No More Snow
description:
Battle your way through 16 unique levels!

Fight your way across high mountains, forest paths, deep caves, graveyards, spooky towns, and even Santa's toy factory. Experience 16 levels in total, all set within Christmas and Halloween themes.

Massive Variety of Weapons - Find Your Favorites!

Choose from a wide selection of firearms and melee weapons found in gift boxes. From lighter options like assault rifles and shotguns to heavy hitters like miniguns, rocket launchers, and flamethrowers, there's something for everyone.

Laid-Back SOLO or CO-OP Action

It’s always more fun to play together! Relax on the couch, grab a controller, and team up with a friend to battle Krampus's minions. While the game is fully playable in single-player mode, having a companion makes things easier and even more enjoyable. This game supports local couch co-op and Steam Remote Play Together but does not feature an online multiplayer mode.

Tons of Enemies and Bosses

Each level introduces new enemy types and culminates in a unique boss fight. Encounter them, discover their weaknesses, and take them down!

Seasonal Updates

Christmas may be over, but the battle between Santa and Krampus rages on! Enjoy free content updates for the summer and Halloween seasons, with even more exciting additions on the way.

Tested on Steam Deck

The game runs perfectly on handheld devices! What’s better than a relaxing shootout to pass the time while you’re on the go?
description_short: Battle your way through Christmas monsters in this laid-back co-op shooter. Equip a variety of firearms and melee weapons, face hordes of enemies and bosses in each level, and take down the evil Krampus.
